combination: Best supported operational tolerance category; arrays do not mean all site categories are compatible.

component_aggregation.disturbance_hardscape: Mean of disturbance and hardscape ratios.
component_aggregation.maintenance_vigour: Mean demand and vigour ratios; explicit control makes high vigour conditional (0.5) under low capacity.

hard_gates.H01_IDENTITY: Unknown scientific identity or plant_id excludes.
hard_gates.H02_INVASIVE_LEGAL: Any explicit positive invasive status (listed_nl, listed_eu, invasive_elsewhere) or legally_prohibited excludes; unknown/nonlisting never clears. Foreign weediness alone is not assigned an invasive status.
hard_gates.H03_WATER_EDGE: Required edge demands waterEdge=yes AND hydrology seasonal|long|permanent|edge.
hard_gates.H04_PERMANENT_WATER: Permanent zone excludes plant lacking explicit operational permanent tolerance. Unknown hydrology requires review for such a plant: permanent water is not ruled out and the plant is never treated as hydrologically compatible.
hard_gates.H05_SUPPORT: Climbing support required but support=false excludes.
hard_gates.H06_PUBLIC_CONTACT: Public access and known unsuitable public contact excludes.
hard_gates.H07_WOODY_GEOMETRY: Tree/shrub cannot fit full spread square and area: exclusion at placement, unsuitable candidate. A known misfit at candidate stage and unknown geometry require review; neither reads as passed.
hard_gates.H08_VIGOUR: Low maintenance plus high vigour and no explicit active control excludes; control=yes conditional. High vigour with unknown maintenance capacity (and no declared control) requires review.
hard_gates.H09_NATIVE_POLICY: Rewilding known introduced excludes. Unknown native in rewilding caps final at 54.
hard_gates.H10_RESTORATION_POLICY: Restoration known introduced needs explicit ornamental override. With the override it requires review and is disclosed by warning restoration_ornamental_exception (rulebook G05). Unknown native status in restoration requires review.
hard_gates.H11_PATH_THORNS: Known thorns/prickles at path edge excludes placement. Known thorns at a mapped path edge during candidate screening, or where path-edge context is unknown, require review. Unknown thorns never clear public-contact use.
hard_gates.H12_MAINTENANCE_CAPACITY: Approved rulebook W03: known maintenance demand above project capacity (demand ratio 0) or unknown capacity requires review/plan revision. It never excludes and never changes points in v0.3.1; whether it should cap or exclude is an open policy question.

eligibility_states.conditional_match: 50 <= final < 65; simulation may proceed with disclosed review items
eligibility_states.unsuitable: final < 50 because of a known environmental conflict, a known spatial/visibility impossibility, or known partial matches that stay below 50 even if every unknown input were resolved favourably
eligibility_states.data_gap: final < 50 only because inputs are unknown: no known conflict or impossibility, and raw + points_withheld_for_unknown_inputs >= the conditional threshold. Rulebook G02 zone_data_gap. Not eligible for ranking and never described as a biological conflict.
eligibility_states.excluded: A hard gate triggered; final = 0. Raw diagnostics are kept.

data_gap_rule: points_withheld_for_unknown_inputs = full weight of each unknown soil/moisture/hydrology/light input + half the disturbance_hardscape weight per unknown disturbance or hardscape input + 0.8 x spatial weight for unknown clear geometry/support length + 0.2 x spatial weight for an unknown required height limit + the maintenance_vigour weight for unknown maintenance capacity. It reports what confirmation could resolve; it is never added to any score.
confidence_formula: Weighted component field confidence × corresponding site-certainty factor × site-source factor × policy factor. Component spatial averages height/spread/spacing/group/support requirement; maintenance and disturbance each average their two fields. Policy factor=max(0.5,1−0.05 per unresolved applicable policy); safety never supplies biological suitability points.
design_preference: 0–100 separate preference average of active colour, month, pollinator and spatial-character/role terms. Ranking position is defined by ranking_stages. Never include excluded/unsuitable/data_gap plants.

ranking_stages.reason: Policy caps tie different biological scores; the uncapped diagnostic separates them.
Rulebook first_release_policy native/local-first: sourced native status before unknown/unreviewed before known introduced. Unknown is never treated as native. Applied only when suitability ties.
Design preference is a tie-break only; it never changes suitability or gates.
Confidence stays a separate number; it orders otherwise tied candidates and is never multiplied into suitability.
Stable final tie-break by Unicode code point (locale independent).

placement: Square clear footprint: woody mature spread, others pilot spacing. Climbers also require support_length>=spacing to pass the spatial screen. Approximate single-species stock capacity=min(floor(width/spacing)×floor(length/spacing),floor(zone_area/spacing²),floor(project_area/spacing²) if known). Climber stock=floor(mapped support_length/spacing). No allocation across species or seed quantities; polygon/path packing remains separate.
space_rule: SPACE-01: tree/shrub spread; climber max(1,spread); herb/graminoid/aquatic ceil(max(0.30,0.90spread)/0.05)×0.05.
environmental_conflict_rule: Known ratio 0 for soil/moisture/hydrology/light/disturbance/hardscape caps final at 49. Unknown values have ratio 0 but warn as gaps, not proven conflicts.
canopy_rule: Context only; no independent effect or doubled light points.
numeric_summation: Every implementation sums component points, confidence terms and design terms left to right starting from 0. Python's built-in sum() is not used for floats because Python >= 3.12 applies compensated summation, which can change a rounded result.

changes: Added data_gap eligibility state and points_withheld_for_unknown_inputs (rulebook G02) so unknown inputs are not labelled unsuitable.

Added review states: H04 unknown hydrology, H07 candidate-stage misfit, H08 unknown maintenance, H10 unknown native and disclosed ornamental override, H11 unknown path edge or candidate stage with known thorns.
Added H12_MAINTENANCE_CAPACITY review gate (rulebook W03); no score change.
Added explicit ranking_stages with native_evidence_tier after raw score (rulebook native/local-first); fixture_id compares by code point.
Specified left-to-right summation so Python and JavaScript round identically.
Weights, compatibility matrices, caps and thresholds are unchanged.
